001package org.clafer.ig;
002
003import java.util.List;
004import java.util.function.UnaryOperator;
005
006/**
007 * A solver of a model behind the solution loop ({@link Repl}): Choco for a
008 * static model, whose solutions are instances, and Alloy for a temporal
009 * model, whose solutions are traces. The loop keeps the solutions shown and
010 * their views; the backend solves, and handles its own commands with its own
011 * messages.
012 */
013public interface Backend {
014
015    /**
016     * A solution as it is shown, with Alloy's XML of it, if any.
017     */
018    record Shown(Solution solution, String xml) {
019    }
020
021    /**
022     * @return whether the model is temporal: its solutions are traces
023     */
024    boolean isDynamic();
025
026    /**
027     * @return the prompt of the loop
028     */
029    String prompt();
030
031    /**
032     * @return the help of the loop's commands
033     */
034    String help();
035
036    /**
037     * Prints what comes before the first solution, which the loop then asks
038     * for.
039     */
040    void start(Repl.Io io) throws Exception;
041
042    /**
043     * The next solution, or null once the backend has said why there is none.
044     */
045    Shown next(Repl.Io io) throws Exception;
046
047    /**
048     * {@code fork}: another trace with the states of the last trace before
049     * the given state, or null once the backend has said why there is none.
050     */
051    Shown fork(Repl.Io io, int state) throws Exception;
052
053    /**
054     * {@code config}: a solution with another configuration, or null once the
055     * backend has said why there is none.
056     */
057    Shown nextConfiguration(Repl.Io io) throws Exception;
058
059    /**
060     * {@code check}: checks the assertions (on the line, if positive), and
061     * shows each counterexample with the loop.
062     */
063    void check(Repl.Io io, Integer line, Repl.Displayer display) throws Exception;
064
065    /**
066     * Handles a command of the backend's own.
067     *
068     * @param words the command and its arguments
069     * @return whether it is one
070     */
071    boolean command(Repl.Io io, String input, List<String> words, Repl.Context context) throws Exception;
072
073    /**
074     * Says that the input is no command.
075     */
076    void unknown(Repl.Io io, String input);
077
078    /**
079     * @return the number of the next solution shown
080     */
081    int number(Repl.Context context);
082
083    /**
084     * The full view of the n-th solution, as the backend prints it.
085     */
086    String show(int n, Shown shown);
087
088    /**
089     * @return the least-partially-qualified name of a clafer by its UID, for
090     * the diff view
091     */
092    UnaryOperator<String> names();
093
094    /**
095     * @return the name of the model's file, which names the saved files
096     */
097    String modelFileName();
098
099    /**
100     * Releases the solver.
101     */
102    void quit();
103}
